Container.Name: no-alias-invoices
Container.Overview:
Local invoice generator with saved recipients, venues and PDF history. Keep the app on your trusted LAN or VPN; it has no administrator login.
MICROSOFT EMAIL (OUTLOOK.COM / HOTMAIL) Set Email provider to microsoft_graph and Microsoft client ID to your Application (client) ID. Multiple servers can reuse that registration while connecting separate mailboxes. It must support personal Microsoft accounts, delegated Mail.Send and public client device-code flows. No client secret or public callback URL is needed.
Open app Settings, choose Connect Microsoft account, open Microsoft's sign-in link and enter the displayed code. Check the connected mailbox and choose Use this account. Microsoft sender is optional: blank uses the connected mailbox; if set, it must match that mailbox. Reconnect, Cancel and Disconnect are available in Settings. Existing connections survive updates. The console command python /app/connect_microsoft.py remains available.
Keep each server's appdata separate and private. The renewable token cache is stored in /data. Do not copy one server's cache to another or share populated configuration screenshots. Public templates leave account values blank.
OTHER EMAIL PROVIDERS Leave Email provider as smtp and configure the SMTP fields. TLS is required. Preserve your existing Appdata, invoice PDF folder and host port when updating.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, invoices, Microsoft token cache and optional private template

Config.Name: Business name
Config.Description: Business name shown in the app and on invoices.

Config.Name: Company logo
Config.Description: PNG/JPEG URL or container path, e.g. /data/logo.png.

Config.Name: Email provider
Config.Description: Use smtp for conventional SMTP providers or microsoft_graph for Outlook.com/Hotmail OAuth.

Config.Name: Microsoft client ID
Config.Description: Application (client) ID. May be shared across servers with separate mailbox authorisations. Connect in app Settings; no client secret is used.

Config.Name: Microsoft sender
Config.Description: Optional expected Microsoft mailbox. Blank uses the connected account; if set, it must match the account confirmed in Settings.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Mail server hostname. Used when Email provider is smtp.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Normally 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for SSL.

Config.Name: SMTP sender
Config.Description: Sender address used when Email provider is smtp.
